translation_notes: RDF.type -> rdf:type and PROF.Profile -> prof:Profile as plain call arguments of graph.subjects(...)

the mechanical draft had inserted the 14 @prefix lines INSIDE the from rdflib.namespace import ( ... ) parenthesised list, which does not parse; the declarations were moved after the import block and reduced to the two prefixes actually used
the import block is kept verbatim on both sides (extracted context; a @prefix produces no runtime object so it never replaces an import)
outside an island there is no a keyword, so rdf:type must be spelled out; the read stays a Python call because ldpy has no island for filtering reads
driver: fixtures pass a duck-typed holder (graph + root_profile_iri) and cover one declared profile, no profile (fallback to root_profile_iri) and an empty graph
